rbr.description: The most classic rally simulation game, Rally Sim Fans version.

tooltip.executable: Select RichardBurnsRally_SSE.exe (or RichardBurnsRally.exe) for a portable RBR installation. The registry is used only when this field is empty.

status.registry: Using the RBR installation found in the registry: {0}
status.missing: Select the RBR executable to use a portable installation.

tooltip.playPacenotesWhenReplaying: Play the pacenotes during replaying finished races.
tooltip.additional_pacenote_def: Pacenote definition db file, contains mapping from rbr pacenote to ztmz pacenote definitions.
tooltip.autoSwitchPacenoteDef: When detected the current track is using the default RBR pacenote, use the default pacenote definition, otherwise, use the definitions in the above pacenote definition file.
tooltip.useInstalledCodriverAudio: Use installed RBR audio for pacenotes and matching countdown, start, finish, and damage calls. Sounds unavailable in RBR fall back to ZTMZ. Disable RBR's own co-driver playback to avoid duplicate calls.

message.selection_NotConfigured: Stage {0}: NGPCarMenu's custom pacenote path is not configured. Using the default mapping; this does not mean Luppis is not installed.
message.selection_Disabled: Stage {0}: custom pacenotes are disabled in NGPCarMenu. Using the default mapping.
message.selection_DirectoryMissing: Stage {0}: the configured custom pacenote directory is missing. Check MyPacenotesPath; using the default mapping.
message.selection_StageMissing: Stage {0}: the custom pacenote directory exists but has no folder for this stage. It may not be covered; using the default mapping. Reinstalling the entire pack is not necessary.
message.selection_DefaultSelected: Stage {0}: NGPCarMenu has default pacenotes selected. Select custom pacenotes in the game if desired.
message.selection_Unknown: Stage {0}: custom pacenote selection is uncertain (missing/conflicting markers, missing file or tied timestamps). Check the in-game selection; this does not establish whether Luppis is installed.
message.custom_pacenote_not_used: Default pacenote is used for current track {0}. It's ok, but Luppis V3 pacenote is recommended. It's also possible that Luppis V3 pacenote doesn't contain the pacenote script for the current track.
